def transform(grid):
    """Mark aligned occurrences of the shared color across the two panels."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = next((i for i in range(1, h - 1)
                    if len(set(grid[i])) == 1
                    and len(set(grid[i-1])) > 1
                    and len(set(grid[i+1])) > 1
                    and grid[i][0] not in set(grid[i-1])), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        first = grid[:row_sep]
        second = grid[row_sep+1:]
        # On stacked panels, the shared comparison color is the least common
        # color shared across both panels (the output's base color).
        shared = set(v for row in first for v in row) & set(v for row in second for v in row)
        color = min(shared)
        return [[3 if a == color and b == color else color
                 for a, b in zip(x, y)] for x, y in zip(first, second)]
    col_sep = next(c for c in range(1, w - 1)
                   if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                   and len({grid[r][c-1] for r in range(h)}) > 1
                   and len({grid[r][c+1] for r in range(h)}) > 1)
    left = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[col_sep+1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    color = min(shared)
    return [[3 if a == color and b == color else color
             for a, b in zip(x, y)] for x, y in zip(left, right)]

def transform(grid):
    # Divider is a uniform row or column. Keep dimensions of the region on
    # the side with the rare marker; transfer marker positions to a blank grid.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r+1<h and len(set(grid[r+1])) == 1), None)
    if div_row is not None:
        a = grid[:div_row]
        b = grid[div_row+1:]
        # demo 3: upper pattern layer has a 0 dot, lower layer has 6 dot;
        # return the upper-layer footprint on a zero canvas.
        src = a
        bg = max(set(v for row in src for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in src))
        out = [[0]*w for _ in range(len(src)-1)]
        for r,row in enumerate(src):
            for c,v in enumerate(row):
                if v != bg and r < len(out): out[r][c] = 3
        return out
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    lc=Counter(v for row in left for v in row); rc=Counter(v for row in right for v in row)
    lmark=min(lc,key=lc.get); rmark=min(rc,key=rc.get)
    # Overlay the sparse marks where both panels carry foreground.
    return [[3 if x==lmark and y==rmark else 9 for x,y in zip(rx,ry)] for rx,ry in zip(left,right)]

def transform(grid):
    # Two 9x9 panels and a zero divider. Their foregrounds are 7 and 5;
    # overlay their intersection as 3 on a 9 background.
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == 0 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    return [[3 if a == 7 and b == 5 else 9 for a, b in zip(x, y)]
            for x, y in zip(left, right)]
